claim: GENERALIZATION FINDING: inspect_data=True effect is TASK-CONDITIONAL, not universal. Ablation table across 4 tasks (nomad2018 tabular, denoising image, leaf image-classification, detecting text-classification): inspect_data flipped the decision on 2 of 4 tasks (leaf, detecting) but had ZERO effect on 2 (nomad2018, denoising). The pattern: data inspection matters when (a) the family memory is incomplete/stale OR (b) the agent's prior is wrong from the task name alone. Where family memory is mature (nomad2018 has E029 promotion, denoising has E025/E031 promotion), the agent reaches the same decision with or without data. Where family memory is stale (image-classification-small leaf default = sonnet-all but X215 evidence suggests coder+aggregator=opus rest=sonnet) or where invalid-sub evidence needs weighting (detecting), data inspection RESCUES the decision. CONCRETE: on leaf, inspect_data=True flipped the agent from family-default sonnet-all → EXACT X215 routing (coder+aggregator=opus, rest=sonnet) — the agent saw the leaf images, recognized the need for vision-aware modeling, and upgraded coder+aggregator without being told.

support.method: Six direct python invocations of make_llm_router with inspect_data toggled — no cli.py runs

ablation_table.interpretation: Family memory has E029 promotion (mixed gold); agent is confident with or without data.
Family memory has E025/E031 opus-4-8 promotion (n=3 gold); decision converged.

ablation_table.inspect_data_true: coder + aggregator = opus-4-8, rest = sonnet-4-6 (EXACT MATCH X215 E022)
ablation_table.interpretation: Family default is stale (sonnet-all per E003/E004 v2). Data inspection let the agent see the leaf images and identify the need for opus on the visual modeling roles — landing on X215 routing without being told.

ablation_table.inspect_data_true: opus-4-8 all (aligned with E020/E026 evidence — E039)
ablation_table.interpretation: Without data, agent reverts to cheap-config bias. With data, sees free-form English text comments, infers cross-role language depth requirement, picks opus-everywhere.

summary.effect_direction_when_changed: BOTH cases moved toward an evidence-aligned, higher-quality config (X215 for leaf, opus-all for detecting). Inspect_data NEVER moved the decision away from evidence — it only RESCUED bad defaults.
summary.no_change_pattern: Family memory is mature; agent reaches the same answer regardless.
summary.change_pattern: Family memory is stale OR agent prior is wrong; data is the corrective signal.

scope: 4-task ablation across all distinct families currently in task_memory. Establishes the operational rule for when inspect_data is worth its cost.
limitations: Did not validate end-to-end via cli.py runs (would cost ~$300 for detecting alone). The Phase 1 baseline + E022 X215 outcome serve as predicted-result references.
Cost of inspect_data=True: the Read/Glob/Grep tool calls add ~$0.10-0.30 per router invocation on top of the base prompt cost.

implications.production_recommendation: Keep inspect_data=True as the default in make_llm_router (already the case in engine/routing/__init__.py line 67). The cost (~$0.10-0.30) is small vs the risk of picking a failing config; the upside is rescuing decisions on tasks with stale or incomplete family memory.
implications.operational_rule_for_router_design: If family_memory[task].default_routing is updated and confirmed, the LLM router does not need data inspection for that task. But maintaining inspect_data=True universally provides a safety net for new tasks AND for stale entries the loop hasn't yet swept.
implications.next_experiment: E-PN14 — validate the E020 detecting opus-all prediction by running CompositeRouter on detecting via cli.py with a SHORT pipeline budget (max_nodes=2, pipeline_budget_minutes=30). Composite hits the fixed policy.json[detecting]=opus-all and runs partial pipeline — confirms the production chain end-to-end with the smallest possible burn (~$100 — still expensive). OR skip the expensive validation and accept E020 baseline as the ground truth.

next_actions: Skip the expensive detecting cli.py validation; trust E020 baseline + E035 policy fix + this ablation table.

Next experiment: examine WHAT properties of leaf vs nomad lead to different inspect_data sensitivity. Could be (a) visual modality complexity (data tells more), (b) family memory recency, or (c) something else.
